name: History Analysis
description: Provides Socratic history tutoring that guides students through historical thinking skills -- context, causation, evidence evaluation, and perspective analysis -- through guided discussion rather than delivering a history lecture. Use when a student asks for help analyzing a historical event, understanding historical causation, evaluating primary sources, or preparing for history coursework. Do NOT use for history lesson plan creation (use `lesson-plan-design`), for writing history essays (use writing category skills), or for non-history subjects.
